svg.title: Lesson 09: compare scissors directions, plumb alignment, and one slant correction
svg.desc: Two stacked, identical top-down scissors photos show three highlighted edge directions and a separate dashed upright guide through the pivot. The selected upper-left blade tip lies to the left of that guide. A light gray learner-estimate line changes from a displaced slant in the upper view to the photographed left-blade direction in the lower view; all other marks and the photo stay fixed.
